title: New Releases: Fantasy Wonderland RPG Music, Hero Character Generator for MZ, KR Legendary Palaces - Yeti Tileset

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
Three new and varied packs for your games! New Music, New Character Generator Parts, New Tiles!
​
Give your maps and cutscenes the right vibes with the Fantasy Wonderland RPG Music pack! 10 BGM tracks offer up something spooky, something quirky, and something dangerous with their synth instruments and catchy melodies. Use this pack’s three versions of ‘Serenade’ to quickly remind your players of an overarching theme to the quests, with the upbeat piano version playing the first time they learn of the quest, then changing to the spooky version with jingling chimes repeats the melody when your heroes discover the truth behind the quest. When they’ve finally finished, give them their hard-earned rewards while the full version of ‘Serenade’ plays with a bunch of strings, horns, and drums all building to a dramatic end. Fill a lonely cathedral with the haunted organ tunes of ‘Requiem for the Restless’ or use the organ in ‘Stained Glass Shadows’ to add a sense of unease to a quiet village your heroes just reached.
Get your players’ toes tapping with the upbeat electric guitars and piano of ‘Ghostly Giggles’ while they’re exploring dungeons or mysterious basements, and have them battle phantasmical foes while electric guitars rip in the background thanks to ‘Midnight Mass Murmurs’. Each track comes in M4a and looping Ogg file formats, so you can add them to your current RPG Maker project or use them in your favorite engine! Pick up the Fantasy Wonderland RPG Music pack and set the mood with songs with repeated melodies or tunes with underlying sinister tones in an otherwise peace-looking village!
Purchase now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Turn your hero into a samurai, a cyborg, a space ranger, or even a vampire prince with the Hero Character Generator for MZ pack! Gee-kun-soft is back with another excellent MZ-style generator part pack for your male characters, with 57 pieces to dress your heroes for success! 3 AccA, 9 AccB, 2 Beard, 2 Cloak, 20 Clothing, 5 Eyes, 1 Facial Mark, 2 Glasses, 1 Mouth, 1 Wing, 5 Front Hair, and 5 Rear Hair parts are perfect for making all of your male party members and important NPCs memorable compared to the normal citizens in your game. Give your serious soldier party member a short and low maintenance haircut while your brash barbarian has wild long hair barely contained in a ponytail, or show how a character is changing by switching his long flowing hairstyle into a short, loose style with bangs after he makes an important decision. Dress your agility-based fighters in lightweight cloth outfits so they can zip around the battlefield while your samurai are decked out in powerful armor and a gilded helmet to draw the enemy’s attention. Give your game a sci-fi flair with some military uniforms for your hero that he can swap out for strength-enhancing cybernetic armor, and make sure your fantasy hero is properly dressed in a flashy suit when he’s getting knighted by a king!
Don’t forget the little things to take your hero’s design to the next level! Give him a mouth with a fang sticking out to remind your players that he’s not completely human, or add a scar across his face after he loses a fight to his best friend after he’s revealed to be working with the villain the whole time! Let him grow his hair out or grow a beard while time passes in the game, or give your players the choice to switch up his looks depending on what outfits they’ve unlocked. If you’ve been wanting some new looks for your male party members in your fantasy or sci-fi games, pick up the Hero Character Generator for MZ pack!
Purchase now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Build an icy castle hidden deep in the wild frozen mountains or a dungeon filled with hairy beasts with the KR Legendary Palaces - Yeti Tileset! Kokoro Reflections continues their Legendary Palace series with one ready to chill your heroes to the bone. Create hallways lined with deadly icicle pits, treasure rooms with slippery floors that can send your heroes careening into palace guards, and throne rooms where statues of all the previous yeti kings are carved into ice! This pack’s A1, A2, A4, A5, and B tiles all look cold to the touch with cool blues and whites making up almost every piece. Build a dungeon entrance out of craggy stone with gray, blue, and white ice debris pushed into the corners, and eventually have the stone make way for tiled blue walls and smooth white floors. Decorate with icicles that were carefully carved into pillars and statues of the castle’s fuzzy inhabitants, and place snowflake-shaped magic circles around the palace to make it easy to get from one hallway to another! When your heroes finally make their way to the throne room, take a moment for them to stare in awe at the iced dias and throne before the boss battle begins.
This pack also includes character sprites for glowing ice gems and frozen treasure chests. Help your heroes navigate maze-like hallways by having the wall-mounted diamond-cut gems glow stronger when they’re on the right path, or light up darker parts of the castle with the different sizes depending on how far into the castle your heroes are. And don’t forget to reward exploration with pointed treasure chests carved from hunks of ice that you can tuck away in all sorts of castle corners and behind challenging puzzles or battles! If you’ve been wanting to add a unique take to your ice dungeons or want a good reason to add some yetis to your game, check out the KR Legendary Palaces - Yeti Tileset!
Purchase now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!

It's very difficult to just listen to music and say with certainty "this is generated," just like it is with graphical art.
In both cases a person could refute you and say "No, I just suck at making it" - without actually seeing them create the art, how could you know the difference between a generator and a person doing it badly?
But there are certainly indicators, such as speed of production; complexity of the music, chord progressions and harmonies; vocals are often a giveaway because they'll sound fuzzy or have unrealistic declamations, just like speaking AI voices.
